goal: Disconnect HTTP clients that fail to finish sending a request within the RPC timeout
Prevents slowloris trickle attacks from exhausting connection slots and blocking legitimate users
agreement: Substantive support with no open objections
Verified by testing slow and fast requests using socat and wireshark (pinheadmz)
Concept support noting that it mitigates slowloris attacks (pinheadmz)
Supported after test cleanup and timing assertions were addressed (hodlinator)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because unauthenticated clients trickling bytes can occupy all connection slots and block RPC access
Fixes a denial of service vector where the idle timer continually reset without completing a request
